summary: La Plata County, CO tower in the San Juan National Forest, built in 1915; taken down; registered 2009 as US 543, CO 15. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Register says the tower has been taken down; no removal date given

events.note: Registered September 18, 2009 as US 543, CO 15; nominated by Susan Epstein

evidence.quote: This tower was built in 1915 and has been taken down.

evidence.supports: tower taken down; the register says nothing about what remains at the site

notes_for_editor: Two short sources only. The brief's cohost pages (firelookout.org/cohost-co/wallace.html and http://www.firelookout.org/cohost-co/index.html) return HTTP 404 from the cache, so no longer account of the tower was read. A search snippet that points to that cohost page mentions a 1915 photo, a 2009 investigation, a 1908 earlier structure and an 'Old Durango National Forest' name. None of this is in the story or quoted, because the page could not be read; the forest name conflicts with firetower.org's San Juan National Forest. The brief's county (La Plata), coordinates and elevation (3279.6 m) match the sources. No staffing, fire or access information was found. Editor should check whether the cohost pages moved.
